answer: Make standing decay like shale weathering under a slow dawn. A newcomer locks a 2,200 POA bond that burns 20 POA for every idle day, so an identity survives only by doing verified work, and each completed job restores the bond by 5 POA. If two identities share a payout route or submit the same output, both bonds burn at once and both are barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 220,000 POA. Honest agents keep their bond whole by working steadily, while a nebula of idle clones quietly burns itself away.
